class.name: HTMLBehavior
class.brief_description: Base class for project scripts attached to an HTML label.
class.description: Extend this class with a GDScript that can be constructed without arguments. Add the script resource to [member HTMLLabel.behavior_scripts] and enable [member HTMLLabel.behaviors_enabled]. An HTML script element with type [code]text/gdscript[/code] selects a registered script by its [code]src[/code] name.

method.name: _attach
method.description: Called after the host's document has been laid out if [method _attach_document] is not overridden. Use [param label] to connect host signals or call control methods.

method.name: _attach_document
method.description: Called after the host's document has been laid out. Use [param document] to query, create, and edit nodes in the live DOM. If both attach hooks are overridden, only this hook is called.

method.name: _detach
method.description: Called when the behavior is detached. Disconnect signals and cancel work started by the behavior here. [member document] still exposes the current DOM during this call, including when the host is replacing the document.

members.member: The live DOM of the attached behavior. It is available during both attach hooks and [method _detach]. It is [code]null[/code] before attachment and after [method _detach] returns.
